resolution: Fixed the embedded-GLB mapping regression shown on Bald Head: the loader was copying supposed source texture coordinates only after setPaintTarget had overwritten those UV lanes with its generated paint-atlas layout. Import now decodes the image and snapshots exact absolute TEXCOORD_0 corners before paint-target adoption, then applies that owned image/corner pair after quad grouping and paint-layout setup before stashing the final edit mesh. Added a native regression proving the source snapshot survives later in-place UV replacement; test-mesh-import, test-model-paint, all five paint-variant tests, and the ReleaseFast editor build pass.
